title: Deposit Pre-Order Cancellations at Will: Charge Kept, Deposit Refund and the Customer's Confirmation (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
### Policy

When a customer cancels an unallocated Deposit Pre-Order at will, Marlowe & Finch keeps a cancellation charge from the deposit and refunds the rest of the deposit to the original card, and the customer confirms that cancellation in person. A cancellation at will of any other Pre-Orders & Back-Orders type before its cutoff is still refunded in full. The customer's confirmation, the cancellation, the charge kept and the refund of the rest are booked together, the cancellation first.

The cancellation charge is fixed only after the reserved unit price stands at the reservation's protected reserved price. While the reservation record shows a reserved unit price other than the reservation's protected reserved price, no cancellation charge is fixed on it.

### Scope at a glance

| Reservation | Cancellation at will |
|---|---|
| Deposit Pre-Order, not allocated | A cancellation charge is kept from the deposit, the rest is refunded to the original card, and the customer confirms in person |
| Any other type, before its cutoff | Refunded in full |

### Records after the customer's confirmation

- The reservation shows status cancelled, dated today, for reason customer request.
- Its history shows two deposit entries: the charge kept and the refund of the rest to the card the deposit came from.
- Together the two entries take the whole deposit held, so nothing of the deposit remains held on the reservation.

### Console action: `confirm_preorder_cancellation_aa3f8734`

**Capability.** With this action the customer personally confirms the cancellation of their own Deposit Pre-Order that has not been allocated, and that confirmation settles its deposit. One call cancels the reservation at the customer's request, dated today, and books two deposit entries on it: the cancellation charge kept and the refund of the rest of the deposit to the card the deposit was charged to.

**How it is invoked.** The action belongs to the customer. The agent unlocks `confirm_preorder_cancellation_aa3f8734` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `reservation_id` | The reservation number of the Deposit Pre-Order being cancelled | As returned by the reservation lookup |
| `cancellation_charge_usd` | The part of the deposit kept as the cancellation charge; recorded on the history as a deposit entry taken out of the deposit | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when nothing is kept |
| `deposit_refund_usd` | The part of the deposit refunded to the original card; recorded on the history as a deposit entry taken out of the deposit | USD, non-negative, 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when nothing is refunded |

**Return.** A successful call returns:

- `reservation_id`
- `status`, always "cancelled"
- `cancelled_date`, today
- `cancel_reason`, always `customer_request`
- `charge_entry_id` and `cancellation_charge_usd`, the amount-kept entry and its amount, USD with 2 decimal places
- `refund_entry_id` and `deposit_refund_usd`, the refund entry and its amount

A returned status of "cancelled" means the cancellation and both entries were recorded.
